summary: Bound workspace discovery and verify sequential refactoring scope

delivery.outcome: Koru workspace globs select only intended checkout depth, avoid generated/vendor trees and symlink escapes, and retain bounded sequential retry semantics. Verify with real autogrammar refactoring pilots and digest-bound wellmanifest/performance evidence. Bound POSIX command execution to 30 minutes and one MiB per output stream; timeout and launch failures remain retryable records. Unsupported pipe platforms fail explicitly. Publish through protected exact-head validation and merge.
nonGoals: No arbitrary edits in dirty or unselected repositories

architecture.decision: Match include globs one path segment at a time, bound traversal, and treat Git checkout roots as scan boundaries. Keep command execution serial and retry only failures. Use a POSIX process group and nonblocking bounded pipe reads, including inherited pipes in the deadline; no new public options or dependencies.
architecture.rollback: Revert workspace-loop changes and their tests together.

validation.evidence: Workspace selection, bounded subprocess behavior, sequential retries and managed gates
